notes:
BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING): the pinned upstream is a ROS 1 topic-only bridge. Its primary control is a fire-and-forget mujoco_ros_msgs/JointSet publication; the repository contains no ROS service or action. The only stop-like ROS inputs are std_msgs/String payloads on /mujoco_ros_interface/sim_command_con2sim: 'pause' toggles settings.run (a second message resumes) and 'mjreset' sets reset_request, which rosPollEvents consumes with c_reset and which then reruns a RESET/INIT controller handshake with up to 1.0 s waits (mujoco_ros/src/mjros.cpp:98-129, 146-153, 5-43, 442-498). Neither payload is acknowledged, and no mujoco_ros node publishes a pause acknowledgement. RosDriver accepts a safe-state action or e-stop binding only as an acknowledged service or action, so a genuine stop cannot be declared. The package was not reduced to observation-only metadata: the joint command is declared and exercised against the fake. A zero JointSet publication is transmission-only and is not offered as a stop.

There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only RosDriver for ROS 1. Primary control is x-cap.saga0619.joint_position_command.v1 and x-cap.saga0619.joint_torque_command.v1, each one mujoco_ros_msgs/JointSet publication on /mujoco_ros_interface/joint_set with MODE 0 or MODE 1 and a caller-supplied body time (README.md:38; mujoco_ros_msgs/msg/JointSet.msg:1-10; mujoco_ros/src/main.cpp:164-172; mujoco_ros/src/mjros.cpp:47-96). Observations are one fresh sensor_msgs/JointState sample from /mujoco_ros_interface/joint_states, one fresh mujoco_ros_msgs/SensorState sample from /mujoco_ros_interface/sensor_states, and one fresh std_msgs/Float32 sample from /mujoco_ros_interface/sim_time (README.md:32-34; mujoco_ros/src/mjros.cpp:270-336). The resource snapshot is deliberately empty: state_publisher runs only while settings.run is true (mujoco_ros/src/mjros.cpp:504-508), so the three topics are explicit observations and a paused simulator waits for the observation deadline instead of returning a cached sample. The package declares no numeric Limit: the clone states no joint travel, velocity, torque or sensor range, and the array lengths are properties of the operator's MJCF model (m->nu, m->njnt, m->nsensor, m->sensor_dim), not numbers the clone states.

FAKE AND FIDELITY: fake.py is a ROS-free analytic contract fake implemented with the SDK's RecordingRosTransport; it does not replay captured traffic and it is not an upstream simulator run. It answers the three subscriptions with fixed placeholder samples (smaller than the real model-sized arrays, disclosed in the fidelity gaps) and records JointSet publications. Fidelity is F0, engine 'analytic:ROS contract fake (no physics)', determinism none, timestep_ms 0, realtime_factor 0, reset none, snapshot_restore false. It runs no MuJoCo, mj_step, controller, actuator, contact or sensor model. Every numeric canned value is marked placeholder.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps the required check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds eleven repository cases: position-mode publication shape, torque-mode publication shape, refusal of a command without sim_time with no publication sent, the JointState and SensorState observation shapes including the user-information entry, the sim_time sample, a malformed JointState reply as a failed receipt, a silent JointState subscription as a timeout/not-ready receipt, a transport failure as a failed or unknown receipt, the absent acknowledged stop with the latch refusal, and a direct call with a short deadline. The non-gate cases pass locally. The gate case remains the unmodified empty-failed assertion and fails only because of the upstream stop gap and the publication-only TCAP-003 effect.

NOT COVERED: /mujoco_ros_interface/sim_command_con2sim, /mujoco_ros_interface/sim_command_sim2con, /mujoco_ros_interface/applied_ext_force, the SimStatus aggregate pub_mode, the shared-memory transport, the graphical UI, the loaded MJCF model and its actuator/sensor dimensions, endpoint namespace/remapping, rosbridge deployment, live ROS compatibility and any hardware.
